Extend this precise portrait into a complete body. Image 2 is only the selected option3 sunny fantasy adventure atmosphere and camera/style reference; do not reproduce its UI or scene.
Character: SAME man in every cell, same outfit/anatomy/scale. Complete black/charcoal chest and shoulder armor, copper-gold trims, orange cloth accents, dark fitted armored trousers, matching black/copper greaves and sturdy boots. One large BATTLE AXE held with two hands, distinct single broad silver cutting blade, orange-black axehead side plate and flat rear poll, short thick brown wrapped haft. It is unmistakably an AXE, not a gun, not a rifle, not a flamethrower, not a hammer. No helmet.

Match the refined clean cel-painted illustration and warm colored outlines of Image1, simplified readable game-sprite detail, warm daylight, bright friendly adventure mood. NOT realistic rendered photograph.
Layout: exactly four whole characters in four equal invisible square cells, separated by ample clear transparent gutters. Row-major order top-left idle, top-right windup, bottom-left release, bottom-right recovery. Every silhouette and axe entirely inside its own cell with at least40pixels safe gutter on all sides; no crossing between cells or cropping. Fixed camera and identical anatomy size, one shared standing crown-to-boot scale. Projected midpoint of boot ground contacts near center x50%, y84% within each cell; normal idle head crown near y24%, keeping safe space above raised axe.
Poses: idle=grounded relaxed low two-handed axe ready with clear friendly face. windup=two hands lift the complete axe diagonally overhead while knees/waist load, visibly different from idle. release=committed forward/down axe cleave with extended arms, forward torso and wide braced stance, single axe blade pointing to lower right. recovery=lower sunk stance and bent elbows retracting axe low across thighs, visibly different from release.
Constraints: exactly four keyposes, no extra figures. Genuinely transparent alpha background and all cell gutters. No ground, scenery, background, shadow, swirls, motion streaks, slash effects, outlines around cells, grid lines, frame, labels, text, UI or watermark. Complete hair, feet, hands and axe uncut in every cell. No full-body gun soldier, no old realistic art.
